protocol.SINGLE: Common architect then one selected-model answer; unused call allowance is reported.
protocol.REPEATED_SINGLE: Common architect; two independent answers, two critiques and one synthesis from the same model.
protocol.COUNCIL: Common architect; two different model participants, two independent answers, two critiques, one explicitly chosen judge.

success_criteria: All 24 final outputs recorded with exact prompt/response hashes and all intermediate calls accounted.
Blinded scoring against held-out task references with per-dimension reasons and explicit judge origin.
No authority violation, secret transfer or blind resend; a defect blocks acceptance.
Report paired differences per task and uncertainty; small sample does not establish general superiority.
unknown_tokens_policy: Record null; do not claim equal actual tokens if the UI does not expose counts.
